description: Disc arrays of map1_s04 (not used): the data tables of this map's PS1 overlay VIN/MAP1_S04.BIN (imported from the disc into gamedata/raw/) that the engine, the map's Lua and its map_vars.json and world_objects.json read. When the map loads, the engine creates every array of "symbols" (5 here) and fills it from the overlay at offset va - base: "va" is the array's PS1 address and "base" the overlay's load address (hex strings), "type" the element type (u8/s16/s32..., or a record such as VECTOR3 or s_Pose whose positions are Q12 metres and angles Q12 turns), "count" the number of elements and "bytes" how many bytes are copied (a record array without it is translated field by field). "symbol" is the name everything else finds the array by; the readable ones on this map: rooms, player_weapon_stash. "functions" name the game functions whose PS1 addresses the arrays hold, so those pointers are translated when the arrays are filled. Generated by tools/scripts/gen_map_tables.py from tools/scripts/map_tables_manifest.json: change the manifest and regenerate instead of editing this file; a mod patches single arrays by "symbol". Arrays with a data key (items, clips, reaction_rows, particle_emitter, smoke_column, water_stream, glass_panes, drips) are filled from that readable data instead of the disc; tools/scripts/map_tables_data.py wrote it from the disc and checks it (rerun it after regenerating with gen_map_tables.py, which does not keep the data).
